evidence_items.locator: Section 3.2, paragraph preceding discussion of cross-distribution results
evidence_items.explanation: The experiments show that trained BERT models could perform well on familiar distributions while failing changed distributions within the same logical problem space. This supports the continued concern about robust learned inference, but not the entire compound claim.

The same paper constructs parameters that implement logical reasoning. This limits any categorical reading that neural architectures lack a way to perform inference, while leaving the observed training and generalization problem intact.

unresolved_gaps: The collected evaluations do not establish the status of all four listed capabilities.
A sufficiently complete, independently documented comparison of the relevant 2012 and 2022 success criteria was not established.
The wording does not resolve whether continued concerns preserve the original categorical formulations.
